beads_commands.stdout_tail: Updated tdmem-0303: Create the TraceDecay Native provider adapter crate

argv: Added the isolated TraceDecay Native provider adapter crate with stable identity enforcement, mockable application ports, capability-gated routing, unchanged canonical calls, and no duplicate Native state or algorithm.

Evidence: crates/tracedecay-memory-provider-native is a strict Rust 2024 workspace crate whose only dependency is tracedecay-memory-provider-api. NativeProvider accepts only a NativeMemoryApplicationPort declaring tracedecay.native, delegates descriptor and handshake, routes health/observe/recall to distinct narrow port methods, routes only declared optional lifecycle capabilities, rejects wrong targets and undeclared operations through the port's typed Native terminal authority, and owns no database, index, scoring, curation, graph, privacy, transport, or persistence state. The application port retains authoritative exact-scope digests, provenance, receipts, temporal/trust semantics, and rejection diagnostics, so the adapter cannot fabricate them. Focused tests prove wrong-ID construction failure, exact handshake scope, byte-identical payload and request-control propagation, mandatory routing, declared lifecycle routing, explicit unsupported behavior without invoking lifecycle, wrong-target and handshake misuse rejection, deterministic capability reporting, and absence of adapter-owned mutable memory. Root workspace and lock wiring are convergence-mapped and all API/fabric/binding/patch gates remain green.
